records.task: RF905 actual outbound awaiter cancellation fixture sequencing
records.rootCause: Peer release is queued after actual stop/join, but peer self-times out in 10s. The outbound worker waits for the unresponsive peer Noise frame and transport permits 30s reads; no stop deadline guarantees completion before the peer timeout. Current failure occurs in fixture channel timeout/send, not in the preserved cancellation/activity assertions.
preserved: real TCP outbound through production sync_with_peer
actual async awaiter abort and is_cancelled assertion
maintenance ACTIVE while cancelled awaiter worker still held by peer barrier
production stop_and_wait join followed by maintenance admission
10s fixture fail-safe timeout and independent network_interrupt test unchanged
